data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'Kæd', meaning pure or clear. The name Kattie is a diminutive of Catherine, which means pure or clear. The name Kattie carries the meaning “Pure, Quiet, or Little” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Kattie usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, quiet, or little and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Kattie
in_english.meaning: Female diminutive form of Katherine, short form of Catherine, diminutive of feminine names, smaller, less, shorter
in_english.long_meaning: The female given name Kattie is a diminutive form of Katherine, which is derived from the Aramaic name Aikaterine, meaning “pure” or “pure one.” The name Katherine is also associated with the Hebrew name עיטי (Qetti), meaning “little” or “young one.” In the New Testament, Katherine is mentioned as the wife of Philip the Apostle and the mother of the apostles. The name Katherine has been popularized in Christian tradition due to its association with Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a 4th-century martyr and scholar. In modern times, the name Kattie is often used as a shortened form of longer names such as Katherine or Catherine. It is also used as a standalone name, symbolizing the qualities of purity, innocence, and youthfulness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kattie has historically been popular in the English-speaking world and is often associated with a sense of sweetness, friendliness, and playfulness. In fiction and media, the name has been given to various characters who exhibit these traits, such as the beloved character Kat from the novel "Wuthering Heights" or the spirited and loving Katie in the television show "The Office". This cultural association with friendliness and playfulness has likely influenced how people perceive and interact with individuals named Kattie.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kattie, as a diminutive of Catherine, carries with it the deeper spiritual meaning of purity and clarity. This name is a reminder to strive for a pure and clear heart and mind, seeking to eliminate impurities and distractions. In Christian spirituality, this can be seen as a call to live a life in accordance with the teachings of Christ, seeking to emulate His example of love, compassion, and humility. Ultimately, the name Kattie serves as a reminder to live a life marked by purity, both in actions and in intentions.
